name: velographx-ablation-suite
description: Reproducible paired ablations using measurements already exposed by VeloGraphX benchmarks. Hardware-sensitive NUMA, thread-scaling, and perf-counter campaigns are defined separately.

interpretation.intersection: Compare scalar/galloping/bitmap/SIMD-adaptive intersection paths emitted by the intersection benchmark.
interpretation.compression: Compare varbyte, blocked-varbyte, fixed-width scalar decode, and fixed-width vectorized decode.
interpretation.incremental: Compare incremental repair against full recomputation across the required update-fraction crossover points.
